# Fixture Guideline on Glove Use

## Purpose

This fixture document exists only for automated tests. It describes glove use in a deliberately simple way, e.g. when to wear gloves and approx. how long hand hygiene takes. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene. Dr. Smith reviewed the text in Fig. 2 of the fixture.

## Procedure

1. Perform hand hygiene for 20–30 seconds with alcohol-based handrub.
2. Select gloves of the correct size.
3. Don gloves immediately before the task.
   Continuation line belonging to step three.
4. Remove gloves and perform hand hygiene again.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Handrub contact time | 20–30 s |
| Storage temperature | 2–8 °C |
